fixture.query_sql: SELECT k,count(*) AS n FROM bench_raw_integer_count GROUP BY k
setup_sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE bench_raw_integer_count(k int4,value boolean,qualifies boolean)

INSERT INTO bench_raw_integer_count SELECT CASE WHEN i%97=0 THEN NULL::int4 ELSE ((g - 2048) * 32749 + 42)::int4 END, CASE WHEN i%7=0 THEN NULL::boolean ELSE i%2=0 END, CASE WHEN g=0 THEN false WHEN i%11=0 THEN NULL::boolean ELSE i%3<>0 END FROM (SELECT i,CASE WHEN i>4096 AND i%5=0 THEN 0 ELSE (i-1)%4096 END g FROM generate_series(1::bigint,500017) s(i)) fixture
